entries.title: II Corinthians 10:1
segments: And I myself, Paul, beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ; I, who indeed to look upon [am] lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:2
segments: But I ask, not being present, that I may be bold with the confidence which I think to be daring against some, who thought [of] us as walking according to flesh.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:3
segments: For though walking about in flesh, we do not war according to flesh.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:4
segments: For the weapons of our warfare [are] not fleshly, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds,

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:5
segments: pulling down imaginations and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought into the obedience of Christ;

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:6
segments: and having readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:7
segments: Do you look at things according to appearance? If anyone has persuaded himself that he [is] Christ's, let him think this again as to himself, that as he [is] Christ's, even so we [are] Christ's.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:8
segments: For even if I also should boast somewhat more fully of our authority (which the Lord has given us for building up, and not for pulling you down) I will not be put to shame;

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:9
segments: so that I might not seem to terrify you by letters.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:10
segments: For indeed they say, the letters [are] weighty and powerful, but the bodily presence [is] weak, and his speech is contemptible.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:11
segments: Let such a one think this, that, such as we [are] in word by letters, being absent, such [we will be] also in deed when we are present.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:12
segments: For we do not dare to rank or compare ourselves with some of the ones commending themselves. But they, measuring themselves among themselves, and comparing themselves to themselves, are not perceptive.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:13
segments: But we will not boast beyond measure, but according to the measure of the rule which the God of measure distributed to us, to reach even to you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:14
segments: For we do not overstretch ourselves as [though] not reaching to you. For we also came to you in the gospel of Christ;

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:15
segments: not boasting beyond measure in the labors of others, but having hope that the growing faith among you will be increased according to our rule, to overflowing;

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:16
segments: to preach the gospel in that beyond you, and not to boast in another's rule in things made ready.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:17
segments: But he who glories, let him glory in [the] Lord.

entries.title: II Corinthians 10:18
segments: For not he who commends himself is approved, but he whom the Lord commends.
